newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - First Financial of Wis.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - First Financial of Wis.

text.p: -- ABN AMRO Chicago Corp said Friday it raised its estimate for First Financial Corp of Wisconsin's earnings for fiscal 1997 by $0.02 to $2.18 a share and initiating an earnings estimate for fiscal 1998 of $2.42.
-- First Financial's fourth-quarter earnings of $0.51 a share beat analysts' consensus estimate by $0.01 and ABN AMRO's estimate for the period by $0.02, the company said.
-- ABN AMRO also reiterated its buy rating for First Financial and raised its price target to $28.
-- First Financial is a savings bank holding comapny.
